item.title: Brownsville airport launches nonstop flights to Orlando: Here's what to know
item.description: BROWNSVILLE, Texas (ValleyCentral) — The Brownsville South Padre Island International Airport announced Wednesday it will begin offering nonstop flights to Orlando International Airport this year. According to a news release, Breeze Airways will provide the air service starting May 15, 2026, with flights operating Mondays and Fridays year-round.
